title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Is it Haram, Makrouh, or permissible to name my son as Michelle or daughter as Suzzane? 4208 views Q. My wife is expecting. She would be delivering in a few days. I have heard that if a person makes niyat that he would name the newborn as Muhammad, then he would be gifted with a son. I had decided in my mind that Insha Allah I would name my first born "Muhammad Imdadullah", with due to respect to the prophet SAS and love for the saint Haji Imdadullah Makki (RAH). But on consulting an aalim, he has said that the name is a mismatch. I'm in a predicament, whether I can add Haji sahab's name to the name Muhammad or not? Please guide me. 2801 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 48426 Country: India Title: Babay name Question: I have a new born baby. He was born on 28 August 2013 time 9:20 pm. Please suggest a name from the holy Quran. Answer ID: 48426 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1328/1328/M=11/1434) Please choose any name among the below mentioned names as per your choice: Safwan, Salman, Hassan, Huzaifa, Talha, Saeed, Rasheed, Mahmood, Masood. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
